info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to disappear,to perish,to get destroyed, to be invisible

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: adarSana honA, nASa honA, diKAI na denA

examples: 'yA preva naSyasi' (f॰10.146.1). praRaSyasi=tiroBavasi, tiroDatse, antarDatse.
'ADiH praRaSyed dviguRe Dane yadi na mocyate' (yAjYa॰2.58).
'tasyAhaM na praRaSyAmi sa ca me na praRaSyati' (gItA 6.30). nityaM sannidaDa ityarTaH. ahaM madBaktasya hadi sannivizwaH, sa ca mayoti tAtparyArTaH.
'pranaMzwumayatizwa ca' (Bawwi॰15.58). pranaMzwuM palAyituM prAyasadityarTaH..
'apanaSya, Dik tvA jAlmAstu' (SAM॰brA॰30.5). apanaSyeti naSerloRmaDyamEkavacane rUpam. apaDvaMsetyAha.
'GoratvaM sampraRaSyati' (BA0 vana0 207.80). sampraRaSyati=vinaSyati=naSyati.
'prajASca tasya kzIyante tataH so'nuvinaSyati' (BA0 SAM0 90.38). saha naSyati samaM vA naSyatItyAha.
'kAmAnusArI puruzaH kAmAnanuvinaSyati' (BA0 12.6533). ukto'rTaH.
'vijYAnaGana evEteByo BUteByaH samutTAya tAnyevAnuvinaSyati' (bf0 u0 2.4.12). anuvinaSyati=tatrEva lIyate.
'avaneSuH kurURAM hi vIryARi arjunAd BayAt' (BA0 4.1728). avaneSuH=tiroBAvaM jagmuH.
'nirnazwanAmakftya-' (rAja0 1.83). nitarAM nazwAni nAmakftyAni yezAM te.
'nizkravyAdamanInaSat' (f0 10.162.2). niranInaSat samUlakAzamakazat, samUlamudacCinat.
'niSamya tallakzmaRamAtfvAkyaM …SanEH SarIre vinanASa SokaH Saradgato meGa ivAlpatoyaH' (rA0 2.44.31)..
'vi zu viSvA arAtayo'ryo naSanta no DiyaH' (f0 10.133.3).
'kriyAH sarvA vinaSyanti grIzme kusarito yaTA' (hitopa0).
'aSastI rvi hi nInaSaH' (f0 6.48.17). vinInaSaH=vyanInaSaH=vyanASayaH. aSastIH=aBiSastIH, dozAropakARi kaTanAni, anizwAni vacAMsi.
'brAhmaRezu pramUQezu Darmo vipraRaSed Druvam' (BA0 13.3083). vipraRaSet, vipraRaSyet, tiroBavet, parABavet.
'api SvapAke Suni vA na dAnaM vipraRaSyati' (BA0 13.3212). vipraRaSyati nizPalaM Bavati.
'avipraRASaH sarvezAM karmaRAmiti niScayaH' (BA0 ASrama0 34.4). Palavanti karmARi Bavanti nAPalAnItyAha.
'yaste yudDamayaM darpaM kAmaM ca vyapanASayet' (BA0) vyapanASayet vinASayet.
'nedimA~llokAnatipraRaSyAni' (Sa0 brA0 6.7.2.16). eByo lokeByo hIyeyeti mA BUt.
'Candasi tu vyAptO vartate. mA no dIrGA aBinaSan tamisrAH' (f0 2.27.14). nigadavyAKyAtam.

examples.text: praRazwApi satI yA'sya manaso na praRaSyati
rAmasya ca mana: kAntA sA kaTaM vinaSizyati
na matkfte vinaSyeyuH sarve te naravAnarAH
